summary: The audit checks the seven first-year required courses (10 units), one core course and one elective, each letter graded with a B- or better (unless the course offers no letter grade), and 30 units in all. A C+ or lower in a required course means retaking it. Checked by hand: the journal club, the RCR ethics mini course, teaching, the qualifying exam and committee meeting, the oral exam and the dissertation. Up to 45 transfer units may count, with at least 90 units at Stanford.
